Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods; the accepted sibling names inside each validator type give the vocabulary (Validate*, Check*, Exceeds*, Determine*, Collect*, Is*).
Method.stretch range: ValidateStretchRangeBounds carries the GroupRangeValidationReason codes 19-22 for a start/end outside 1..65535; the four predicates around it are ContainsNewRange, IsAddressInsideNewRange and IsAddressOutsideNewRange.
Method.max security entries: The Link/Target variants of the max-security-individual-address-entries check name their sender and group-address collectors; the three MaxSecureGroupKeyTableEntry validators share ExceedsMaxSecureGroupKeyTableEntries in their own types.
Method.identical helper: The byte-identical private duplicate 0x06002BB9 (called from the same ValidateRangeToStretch as ContainsNewRange) is left unresolved rather than given a second name.
